### `bayesa_snp.rs` {#sec-masbayes-bayesa_snp}

{{< rust-src masbayes bayesa_snp.rs >}}

BayesA Gibbs MCMC for biallelic SNP markers.

Per-marker variance σ²_j ~ scaled-Inv-χ²(ν, S²) drawn from
  InvGamma( (ν+1)/2, (ν·S² + β²)/2 )
BEFORE β_i each iter. Per-iteration:
  yadj = y - μ - X·α - W·β  (maintained incrementally)
  u    = W·β                (maintained incrementally)
σ²_g per iter = var(u); reported as mean over saved iter.
Binary traits use Albert-Chib augmentation with σ²_e fixed at 1.
